subject: Request: Student Workshop - Bulk Trial Credits for OpenMind EDU
body:
From: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@openmind.edu>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Student workshop — bulk trial credits request

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week. OpenMind EDU is running a regional student workshop on June 14 (approx. 180 attendees). We’re trying to include a practical hands-on section where students can run small NLP projects — would Redwood be able to provide trial credits/promo codes that we can distribute to attendees?

What we need: a pool of 200 small trial credits (usable for model inference — short text & embeddings), unique single-use codes if possible, and an ETA for delivery so we can include them in the pre-event email. Budget is tight, so we were hoping for a complimentary allocation tied to the partnership (we can add Redwood as a workshop sponsor on our site).

I attached a short SOW and tentative agenda. Let me know the best next steps (and if you need a PO or signed SOW).

Sara Lewis
Partnerships Lead — OpenMind EDU
sara.lewis@openmind.edu
Attachment: SOW_OpenMind_EDU_v2.pdf

-----
Reply-To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@openmind.edu>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Student workshop — bulk trial credits request

Hi Sara — thanks for the details and the SOW. Really excited about the event.

Quick proposal: we can provision a total pool of 200 single-use trial codes tied to the OpenMind EDU promo (each code valid for 30 days from activation). We typically do a 150-core complimentary allocation for community workshops and will approve the +50 on a discretionary basis for events tied to outreach and student programs — I’ll loop Marissa for final sign-off.

If that works, please send over the formal SOW signature (DocuSign link or signed PDF). Once approved, Grace from Ops will generate the CSV of codes (promo_codes_OMEDU_202605.csv) and I’ll share delivery instructions for the pre-event email.

Deliverables / Next steps: 
- Marissa: final approval for the 200-credit pool (one-time grant)
- OpenMind: sign SOW (DocuSign fine)
- Ops (Grace): generate single-use code CSV and provide file + usage guide

Thanks — I’ll ping you when Marissa confirms.

Best,
Mateo
BizDev, Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Student workshop — bulk trial credits request

Mateo — approved.

I’m ok with a one-time grant of 200 single-use trial credits for OpenMind EDU, conditional on:
- Signed SOW uploaded to HubSpot (deal attached)
- Tracking note in the deal that these are promotional, non-renewing credits
- Ops to provide the code CSV and confirm rate limits (to avoid accidental overuse at event)

Grace — can you generate the codes and add the file to the HubSpot deal? Please make sure the CSV uses the one-code-per-line format and includes expiration_date field. CC finance if there's any accounting tagging required.

Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachment: none

-----Original Message-----
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@openmind.edu>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Student workshop — bulk trial credits request

Hi Sara — good news, Marissa approved the full 200-credit pool. Attached is the promo CSV (promo_codes_OMEDU_202605.csv) — single-use codes, each code valid for 30 days from activation.

Delivery notes:
- File: promo_codes_OMEDU_202605.csv (attached) — one code per line, columns: code,expiration_date,notes
- Please don’t publish codes publicly; distribute per-attendee via your pre-event email list.
- If you need codes delivered directly to attendees via our redemption API, we can discuss; otherwise the CSV should be fine.

SOW status: we have the SOW attached in DocuSign (linked) — please counter-sign so we can mark the HubSpot deal as closed-won for the promo. HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

Attachments: promo_codes_OMEDU_202605.csv, SOW_OpenMind_EDU_v2.pdf

Thanks and good luck with the workshop — happy to help with a short speaker intro if useful.

Best,
Mateo
BizDev, Redwood Inference

-----Forwarded attachment stubs:-----
promo_codes_OMEDU_202605.csv (text/csv) — 200 lines, one-code-per-line (attachment stub)
SOW_OpenMind_EDU_v2.pdf (application/pdf) — signed once counter-signed (attachment stub)
